prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

When I first moved to college, I was surprised that both my roommates, a Nigerian boy and a Sri Lankan boy, actually used to write detailed letters to their parents back home and not talk as much on the phone. This was for very different reasons though. The Nigerian boy was doing it purely as an exercise to improve writing skills but the Sri Lankan boy often had connectivity issues back home. Whose parents didn't have great phone connectivity at home?
A. The Nigerian boy
B. Can't be determined
C. The Sri Lankan boy
